name: Advance Trip Organizer– Manage Your Trips and Booking
author: Md Hazrath Ali

sections.description:
Advance Trip Organizer– Manage Your Trips and Booking is a powerful WordPress plugin designed for travel agencies, tour operators, and bloggers who want to showcase and manage trips easily.

Features:
* Custom Post Type for Trips
* Destination taxonomy for trip locations
* Custom meta fields (Price and Duration)
* Advanced filter with AJAX for:
– Destination
– Price range
– Duration range
* Shortcode [tripo_destination_search] for displaying filters and trips
* Fully responsive and lightweight design
* Built for speed and SEO-friendly

Perfect for creating a travel booking directory or tour listing platform.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file and upload it to your WordPress site.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Advance Trip Organizer– Manage Your Trips and Booking from the Plugins menu.
  4. Go to Settings > Permalink > Save
  5. Navigate to Trips > Add New to create your first trip.
  6. Use the shortcode [tripo_destination_search] on any page to display the filter and trip listing.
sections.faq:
How do I display the trip filter on my page?

Use the shortcode [tripo_destination_search] on any post or page.

Can I add more destinations?

Yes, you can add destinations under Trips > Destinations in the WordPress admin.

Does it support custom themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any theme. You can override the CSS for a custom look.
